form.template.applied: Template applied. Check the preview, then save.
form.template.body: Pick the kind of business you sell to. The template decides which questions the form asks and which ones are required. Your own questions, texts and consent wording stay as they are, and nothing changes on your store until you click Save.
form.template.desc.distributor: Asks for a tax number, website, phone and expected monthly order value; year established is optional.
form.template.desc.other: The standard form: business details, contact, addresses, optional tax number and documents.
form.template.desc.reseller: Asks for a tax number, a resale certificate and the website or marketplace where they sell.
form.template.desc.restaurant: Asks for a phone number and lets buyers give a separate delivery address and number of sites.
form.template.desc.retail: Asks for a tax registration number; website, number of locations and expected order value are optional.
form.template.desc.salon: Asks for a professional licence or certificate upload and a phone number.

notifications.merchant.mode.weekly.help: One email each Monday (UTC) with pending applications, replies to your questions, expiring certificates and failed actions from the past week. Sent only when there's something to report.
